name: 叠加分析
description: 对两个图层执行交集/并集/差集叠加。
code_template:
import os
import geopandas as gpd

gdf = gpd.read_file('{input_file}')
overlay_gdf = gpd.read_file('{overlay_layer}')
if gdf.crs != overlay_gdf.crs:
    overlay_gdf = overlay_gdf.to_crs(gdf.crs)
result = gpd.overlay(gdf, overlay_gdf, how='{how}')
output_file = '{output_file}'
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_file) or '.', exist_ok=True)
result.to_file(output_file)
show_layer(output_file, '{layer_name}')
print(f'?????: {output_file}')
